notes.title: Release of V1.2.1
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.2.1 has been released![/h2]

It integrates Steam Achievements into the game!


Have fun with the new update!

notes.title: Release of V1.2.0 and exit from Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.2.0 has been released![/h2]

It brings some improvements and new features. 

Changelog:
- Images added to hints
- Images can be enlarged by mouse click
- Background music added
- Volume control for background music added
- Volume control for sound effects improved
- Minor adjustments to a few hints

This version also marks the end of Early Access.

Have fun with the new update!

tags.feature: - Images can be enlarged by mouse click
- Volume control for background music added

tags.balance_change: - Volume control for sound effects improved
- Minor adjustments to a few hints

notes.title: Release V1.1.0
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.1.0 has been released![/h2]

This brings some minor improvements, but also a new case. 

Changelog:
- a new case with a wintry flair
- Language selection with two new languages (German, French)
- information page
- Minor changes and bug fixes


Have fun with the new update and Merry Christmas!

tags.feature: - a new case with a wintry flair
- Language selection with two new languages (German, French)
